versions.changelog: Fixed: Shell script compatibility. Both Python and Shell scripts tested and working. Zero external dependencies for fallback mode.
Added: Bundled scripts (Python + Shell) for fetching TASE data via Finnhub/Alpha Vantage APIs. No Brave Search. Zero external dependencies for API fallback.
Updated: Now uses MCPs and direct APIs instead of web search; improved data fetching strategy for TASE securities
Enhanced: Better TASE integration, ETF number support, improved Hebrew language handling, expanded technical analysis framework

Initial release: Comprehensive fundamental, technical, and valuation analysis for TASE securities with Hebrew language support. Supports TASE tickers, ETF numbers, and Hebrew company names. Features: Fundamental analysis, technical analysis, valuation models, stock comparisons, and bilingual reporting.
